sentences.text: Ranbir Kapoor -LRB- -LSB- rəˈɳbiːr kəˈpuːr -RSB- ; born 28 September 1982 -RRB- is an Indian actor and producer .

The son of actors Rishi and Neetu , and the grandson of actor-director Raj , Kapoor pursued film-making and method acting at the School of Visual Arts and the Lee Strasberg Theatre and Film Institute , respectively .
